evidence_classes.discord_explicit_rule_or_answer: Prescriptive Discord wording or a direct reply to an RB question; kept in the speaker's own text and not assumed universal.

evidence_classes.analyst_synthesis: A deterministic summary of the preceding Discord evidence with scope and sufficiency guards.

methodology.outcome_eligibility: Single-instance actual-or-unspecified episodes with explicit win/loss, attributable setup detail, and an RB linked by the trade extractor.
methodology.chart_policy: Attachments and deictic chart references are flagged. No chart-only geometry, candle state, level, or result is inferred.
methodology.timestamp_policy: All timestamp_utc values are Discord posting times; they are provenance only and are not interpreted as the time an RB appeared.
methodology.targeted_followup_authority_policy: Domme replies are distinguishable from ordinary member replies. Community statements are evidence of Discord discussion, not verified trading rules.
